description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of demonstrations and the accuracy of various models on the BBQ dataset, with the x-axis representing the number of demonstrations on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500 in increments of 250, and the y-axis showing accuracy values from 45 to 55. The plot includes five distinct lines, each representing a different model or method: "Squared Exponential" (solid black line), "Tanh" (solid dark blue line), "ELU" (solid light blue line), "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" (solid purple line), and "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" with a dashed pink line. All models show an increasing trend in accuracy as the number of demonstrations increases. The "Squared Exponential" model starts at approximately 50.5 accuracy and rises to around 54.5, while the "Tanh" model begins at about 50.0 and increases to roughly 53.5. The "ELU" model starts at approximately 48.5 and climbs to about 52.5. The "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" model begins at around 47.5 and reaches approximately 51.5. The dashed pink line for "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" starts at about 47.0 and increases to around 51.0. The "Squared Exponential" model consistently achieves the highest accuracy across all demonstration counts, followed by "Tanh," "ELU," and then the two "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" models, with the dashed pink line consistently lower than the solid purple line.
